types.name: e-Tourist visa (1 month)
types.purpose: Online visa for tourism, sightseeing or visiting friends and relatives.
types.maxValidity: 30 days, multiple entry

types.name: e-Tourist visa (1 year)
types.purpose: Online visa for tourism, sightseeing, short courses, visiting relatives or unpaid volunteering up to one month.
types.maxValidity: 365 days from grant of ETA, multiple entry
types.note: Maximum stay in one calendar year must not exceed 180 days.

types.name: e-Tourist visa (5 years)
types.purpose: Online visa for tourism, sightseeing, short courses, visiting relatives or unpaid volunteering up to one month.
types.maxValidity: 5 years from grant of ETA, multiple entry
types.note: Maximum stay in one calendar year must not exceed 180 days.

types.name: e-Business visa
types.purpose: Online visa for business visits.
types.maxValidity: 365 days from grant of ETA, multiple entry
types.note: Up to 180 continuous days per visit; longer stays need FRRO/FRO registration within two weeks after 180 days.

types.name: e-Conference visa
types.purpose: Online visa for attending a conference, seminar or workshop in India.
types.maxValidity: 30 days from arrival, multiple entry
types.note: Organisers must upload event details to the MHA conference portal.

types.name: e-Medical visa
types.purpose: Online visa for medical treatment in India, including Indian systems of medicine.
types.maxValidity: Portal table says 1 year from arrival; the portal FAQ says 60 days from first arrival
types.note: Official portal pages disagree on validity; check before applying.

types.name: e-Medical Attendant visa
types.purpose: Online visa for a person accompanying an e-Medical visa holder.
types.maxValidity: Portal table says 1 year from arrival; the portal FAQ says 60 days from first arrival
types.note: Two attendant visas per e-Medical visa. Official portal pages disagree on validity.

types.name: e-Student visa
types.purpose: Online visa for study in India.
types.maxValidity: 1 year from grant of ETA, multiple entry

types.name: e-Transit visa
types.purpose: Online visa for travel through India to another country.
types.maxValidity: 30 days from first arrival, multiple entry

types.name: e-Miscellaneous visa (e-X1)
types.purpose: Online visa for miscellaneous purposes.
types.maxValidity: 3 months from first entry, multiple entry

types.name: e-Production Investment visa
types.purpose: Online visa for production investment business purposes.
types.maxValidity: 6 months, multiple entry

types.name: e-Family visa (e-SX)
types.purpose: Online visa for family members.
types.maxValidity: 1 year from grant of ETA, multiple entry

types.name: Tourist visa (regular)
types.purpose: Recreation, sightseeing, casual visits to friends or relatives, short yoga or non-formal courses.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (10 years for US, Canada, Japan nationals), multiple entry
types.note: Continuous stay per visit is capped (180 days for some nationalities, usually less otherwise); check the visa stamp.

types.name: Business visa (B)
types.purpose: Business ventures, trade, sports, cultural performances, conferences and film work.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years, multiple entry
types.note: FRRO registration is needed if aggregate stay in a calendar year exceeds 180 days.

types.name: Employment visa (E)
types.purpose: Work for an organisation in India by highly skilled or qualified professionals.
types.maxValidity: Up to 2 years or assignment term (3 years for IT sector), multiple entry
types.note: Registration with FRRO/FRO is not required if the visa is 180 days or less.

types.name: Student visa (S)
types.purpose: Full-time study at a recognised institution in India.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years or course length, whichever is less
types.note: At most four entries per academic year.

types.name: Research visa
types.purpose: Research at an Indian university or institute.
types.maxValidity: 3 years or project duration, up to 5 years in total

types.name: Journalist visa (J)
types.purpose: Reporting in India, including journalists visiting for other purposes.
types.maxValidity: Usually up to 3 months
types.note: Multiple entry needs prior approval of the Ministry of External Affairs.

types.name: Medical visa (MED)
types.purpose: Medical treatment in India; attendants get a Medical Attendant visa.
types.maxValidity: Up to 1 year or treatment period, whichever is less
types.note: Up to three entries in a year; extendable by FRRO/FRO up to a further year.

types.name: Conference visa
types.purpose: Attending an international conference, seminar or workshop in India.
types.maxValidity: Set by mission; not above tourist visa maximum of 6 months

types.name: Transit visa (TR)
types.purpose: Direct travel through India to a destination outside India.
types.maxValidity: Single journey, entry within 15 days of issue
types.note: Not needed for air transit if you stay within the airport precincts.

types.name: Intern visa
types.purpose: Internship with an Indian company, institution or NGO.
types.maxValidity: Up to 12 months, renewable once for 12 months (French VIE programme)
types.note: The source covers only the French International Internship Programme; check conditions for others.

types.name: Entry visa X-1
types.purpose: Entry for a person of Indian origin who does not hold an OCI card.
types.who: Persons of Indian origin without OCI
types.maxValidity: 5 years at a time, multiple entry

types.name: Entry visa X-2
types.purpose: Entry for the spouse and children of an Indian citizen, person of Indian origin or OCI holder.
types.who: Family of Indian citizens, PIO or OCI holders
types.maxValidity: 5 years at a time, multiple entry

types.name: Entry visa X (dependants)
types.purpose: Dependants of foreigners on business, employment or study visas.
types.maxValidity: Same as the principal visa holder

types.name: Long Term Visa (LTV)
types.purpose: Long-term stay for minority-community members from Pakistan, Bangladesh and Afghanistan seeking Indian citizenship.
types.who: Hindus, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Parsis, Christians from those countries
types.maxValidity: 5 years at a time; extensions on a two-year basis

types.name: Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card
types.purpose: Lifelong registration giving visa-free entry and residence rights to people of Indian origin and their spouses.
types.who: People of Indian origin and spouses of Indian citizens
types.maxValidity: Life-long
types.note: Not a citizenship; carry a valid passport. Spouse-based initial card is valid 5 years.
